In November 2017, a Montana cattle rancher named Errol Rice flew to Beijing to meet one of China’s richest men. Rice was part of the U.S. commercial delegation that accompanied President Donald Trump on his first trip to the Chinese capital.

The Memorandum of Agreement signed by Errol Rice and Richard Liu, November, 2017. Credit: Steve Daines
